aggregation_policy.benchmark_pass_rule: All applicable integrity gates and the benchmark-specific required-characteristic gate must PASS; REVIEW_REQUIRED blocks automatic PASS.

TECH-DOCX-01.deterministic_method: Inspect OOXML structure and independently cross-check with python-docx; compare structural predicates rather than requiring equal raw counts where parser semantics differ.
TECH-DOCX-01.pass_predicate: paragraphs present AND headings present AND tables present AND complex table markers present AND both structural paths confirm the required feature classes

TECH-MIX-01.deterministic_method: Classify every PDF page by presence of extractable digital text and image-only structure; verify complete page partition.
TECH-MIX-01.pass_predicate: one or more digital-text pages AND one or more image-only pages AND classified page partition covers all pages

TECH-SCAN-01.deterministic_method: Inspect every PDF page for extractable digital text and page image presence; classify image-only pages and OCR need.
TECH-SCAN-01.pass_predicate: one or more pages are image-only with zero extractable digital text and OCR need is positively classified

TECH-TABLE-01.deterministic_method: Scan all PDF pages using the frozen table-detection method; classify pages with observed table structure; group consecutive table pages into runs.
TECH-TABLE-01.pass_predicate: at least one detected table run spans two or more consecutive pages

TECH-XLSX-01.deterministic_method: Inspect OOXML workbook structure and cross-check through the frozen spreadsheet parser path.

failure_policy.DEFERRED: Does not count as PASS or FAIL; indicates that required evidence class does not yet exist.
failure_policy.FAIL: Blocks benchmark quality qualification when a deterministic integrity or required-characteristic predicate is violated.
failure_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: Excluded from the benchmark-specific denominator because the metric is outside the frozen technical characteristic.
failure_policy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Blocks automatic qualification but preserves evidence for human adjudication; it is not silently converted to PASS.

global_metrics.calculation: Resolve binding identity by source_class; require exactly one registry match; compute SHA256 of physical source; compare byte-for-byte hash equality.
global_metrics.name: BOUND_ASSET_IDENTITY_INTEGRITY
global_metrics.pass_predicate: unique_resolver_match AND physical_asset_exists AND actual_sha256 == registered_sha256
global_metrics.semantics: The benchmark binding resolves to exactly one registered asset/source and the current physical file SHA256 equals the frozen registered SHA256.

global_metrics.calculation: Normalize required_format and resolved file_format to lowercase and test exact equality.
global_metrics.name: REQUIRED_FORMAT_CONFORMANCE
global_metrics.semantics: The resolved source format equals the frozen required_format of the technical benchmark.

global_metrics.calculation: Test qualification_status == QUALIFIED and both qualification_method and evidence_summary are non-empty.
global_metrics.name: QUALIFICATION_EVIDENCE_COMPLETENESS
global_metrics.pass_predicate: qualification_status == QUALIFIED AND qualification_method != empty AND evidence_summary != empty
global_metrics.semantics: A qualified technical binding must retain a non-empty qualification method and non-empty evidence summary.

global_metrics.calculation: Compare run identity tuple (asset_sha256, parser_name, parser_version, config_hash).
global_metrics.name: COMPARABLE_RUN_REPRODUCIBILITY
global_metrics.pass_predicate: run_identity_tuple_A == run_identity_tuple_B before deterministic output equality is evaluated
global_metrics.semantics: Two parser observations are repeatability-comparable only when immutable input hash, parser implementation/version, and configuration are identical.

global_metrics.name: EXTRACTION_CORRECTNESS_AGAINST_LABELED_TRUTH
global_metrics.semantics: Extraction correctness metrics such as precision, recall, F1, cell accuracy, heading accuracy, or OCR character accuracy require independently labeled ground truth.

ground_truth_policy.future_activation_requirement: Independent labeled ground truth plus explicit measurement and acceptance contract.

metric_classes.GROUND_TRUTH_METRIC: Metric comparing extracted output with independently established labeled truth; DEFERRED until such truth exists.
metric_classes.INTEGRITY_GATE: Boolean deterministic control protecting asset identity, hash integrity, binding resolution, and format contract.
metric_classes.REPRODUCIBILITY_GATE: Control requiring comparable runs to use the same immutable asset hash, parser implementation/version, and configuration.
metric_classes.STRUCTURAL_CHARACTERISTIC_GATE: Boolean deterministic control establishing only whether the frozen benchmark's required technical characteristic is observably present.
metric_classes.STRUCTURAL_OBSERVATION: Deterministic count/classification emitted for audit and comparison; by itself it is not a quality score.

state_semantics.DEFERRED: The metric would require evidence not yet available, such as labeled extraction ground truth; no synthetic score or threshold may substitute for missing evidence.
state_semantics.FAIL: A deterministic invariant or explicitly required technical characteristic is violated.
state_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The metric is outside the technical characteristics required for the benchmark.
state_semantics.PASS: All deterministic predicates applicable to the metric are satisfied by reproducible evidence.
state_semantics.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Evidence exists but is ambiguous, parser outputs conflict on a contract-relevant predicate, or deterministic adjudication is not defensible.
